📝 Slides
1. what you only realize about your older sibling years later
2. they had to do everything first, with no one to show them how.
3. they took the loudest yells so the hallway would be quiet by the time you got there.
4. they let you win the fights over the front seat and the remote.
5. they were just a kid themselves, even when they felt like an adult to you.
6. they kept your secrets from the kitchen table without ever asking for a favor.
7. they fought all the strict rules so your curfew could be later.
8. send this to the one who went first

✍️ Caption
i didn't see it when we were sharing a hallway,
but i see it now.
thank you for going first.
send this to your older sibling.

#siblings #family #growingup #oldersibling
